goal: Extract the cohesive comparison-related forwarding API from JPlagOptions and leave comparison configuration in a dedicated component.

ops.details: Extract getComparisonMode(), getMaximumNumberOfComparisons(), getMinimumTokenMatch(), getSimilarityMetric(), getSimilarityThreshold(), isDebugParser(), setComparisonMode(ComparisonMode), setDebugParser(boolean), setMaximumNumberOfComparisons(int), setMinimumTokenMatch(Integer), setSimilarityMetric(SimilarityMetric), and setSimilarityThreshold(float), together with their required comparisonOptions dependency.
Update callers to use the extracted comparison option access class or the existing JPlagComparisonOptions instance.
